product_metadata.title: LED Cardinal Christmas Ornament - Light Up Ball Xmas Decoration - Snow & Holly Accents with Greenery & Pinecones
features: CARDINAL MEMORIAL glass bulb ornament with a white votive candle. Approx. 4" diam. with a frosted snow like background. Comes with a 4-hour timer.
CHRISTMAS ORNAMENT. Beautiful cardinal between red gem berries and glittery greenery. Great way to let someone know they are loved.
4-HOUR TIMER battery operated requires 3 LR44 batteries (they are included) and you will get an extra set.
MEMORY KEEPSAKE ORNAMENT They say when cardinals appear angels are near...give this as a gift to anyone mourning the loss of a loved one.

description: Cardinal glass ball ornament. It is approximately 4" diameter and requires 3 LR44 batteries (3 batteries come with the ornament) and also comes with a 4-hour timer. Pinecones and Christmas greenery adorn this beautiful ornament.
